commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone DiceBound fantasy RPG inventory equipment artwork. Square high resolution PNG with genuinely transparent alpha background. Hand-painted detailed fantasy game asset, rich tactile materials, crisp readable silhouette, warm upper-left key light and gentle cool right rim. Entire object fully visible centered with 8% clear padding on every side. Three-quarter view unless clothing requires frontal view. No person, hands, floor, scene, labels, watermark, icon frame or cast shadow plane. This is a base model, not a rarity badge.
